### God Highly Exalted
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-highly-exalted
Passage: Psalm 113:1-9
Points:
- Psalm 113 belongs to the Egyptian Hallel, sung during Passover to celebrate God delivering Israel from slavery.
- The Lord is sovereignly enthroned on high, possessing authority that transcends every earthly nation and ruler.
- Despite His transcendent majesty, God graciously turns His attention to the lowly rather than the self-reliant.
- He reveals His heart by raising the destitute from the dust and giving joy to the childless.
- Those who acknowledge their spiritual poverty and bring nothing of their own find redemption in Christ.
